title: FAI MCP Bundle Manifest v1
description: Canonical schema for the `manifest.json` at the root of a `.fai-mcp` air-gap bundle. The manifest is the single Cosign-signed artifact: `signature.sig` covers these bytes, and these bytes carry the SHA256 of every other file in the bundle. Format spec: frootai-core/docs/specs/fai-mcp-bundle-v1.md ([X6.1]).
$comment: License: CC0-1.0. Authored as part of Phase [X6.2] of the FAI MCP Marketplace + Trust masterplan. Doctrine #4 — NEVER BUNDLE WITHOUT SIGNATURE: a manifest with a valid `signature` block + a verifying `signature.sig` is what makes a bundle attachable behind a firewall.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA256 of the referenced file's bytes.

slug.description: Kebab-case spec slug === the spec filename (doctrine #5).

manifest_version.description: Always 1.0.0 for v1. Bumped only on a breaking manifest-shape change.

name.description: Stable kebab-case bundle identity. Deploy dir is ~/.frootai/bundles/<name>/ ([X6.8]).

created_at.description: ISO timestamp; doubles as SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH for deterministic tar mtimes ([X6.3]).

tier.description: HIGHEST trust tier in the bundle (informational; per-spec trust is authoritative).

spec_count.description: MUST equal specs.length — a cheap tamper check (enforced by the verifier, not the schema).

algorithm.description: v1 signs with Cosign. Reserved for future signers.

public_key_url.description: Where to fetch the verifying key; kernels SHOULD also ship it bundled for true air-gap ([X6.6]).

signature_file.description: Reserved bundle-root path of the detached signature over manifest.json.

logged.description: Whether the signature was logged to a Sigstore Rekor transparency log. Air-gap bundles may set false.

log_index.description: Rekor log index when logged; null otherwise.

packages.description: npm/uvx tarballs the specs' transports reference. Empty for an all-hosted bundle.

path.description: Bundle-relative path of the package tarball/wheel.

manager.description: Drives how the kernel runs the bundled package ([X6.7]).

sbom.description: CycloneDX SBOM reference ([X6.23]). REQUIRED for signed bundles; may be omitted for unsigned.
